svg.aria-label: Enterprise RAG assistant on Azure — hub-and-spoke landing zone
svg.title: Enterprise RAG assistant on Azure — hub-and-spoke landing zone
svg.desc: Employees chat with an assistant grounded on corporate documents. Traffic enters through Front Door, is governed by API Management, and reaches Azure OpenAI and AI Search over private endpoints. Documents are ingested asynchronously. Fictional example.

g.text: Enterprise RAG assistant on Azure — hub-and-spoke landing zone

text.tspan: Entry point. Azure Front Door with WAF terminates TLS and reaches API Management through Private Link, so the backend has no public endpoint.
Governance. API Management validates the Microsoft Entra ID token, applies rate limits and forwards the request to the chat backend.
Private data plane. The backend reaches Azure OpenAI, AI Search and Cosmos DB through private endpoints; public network access is disabled on all of them.
Grounding. The backend retrieves the most relevant chunks from the vector index and sends them with the question to Azure OpenAI; the answer and its citations are stored as chat history.
Asynchronous ingestion. A new document triggers Event Grid, then a Function extracts the text, chunks it, generates embeddings and indexes them. The chat path is never blocked.
Operations. Secrets live in Key Vault and are read with managed identities; telemetry goes to Log Analytics and alerts to Monitor.
